mapper.select: SELECT id, datasource_name, host, port, database_name, jdbc_url, username, status, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM dbview_datasource WHERE deleted = 0 AND datasource_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{datasourceName}, '%') AND host LIKE CONCAT('%', #{host}, '%') AND status = #{status} ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT datasource_name FROM dbview_datasource WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, datasource_name, host, port, database_name, jdbc_url, username, password, status, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM dbview_datasource WHERE deleted = 0 AND datasource_name = #{datasourceName} LIMIT 1
